# Siddur Shoresh
> Root-linked interlinear siddur. Every word of the daily tefillos carries its Hebrew
> root (shoresh); every root lists every prayer it appears in.

32 prayers, 2,821 words, 574 Hebrew roots.
Live: https://siddur-shoresh.vercel.app

## Data
- data.json — prayers[], roots[], stats. Word records: {hebrew, translation, verse, shoresh}.
- scripts/ — per-tefillah builders; data.json is reproducible from them.
- docs/SHORESH_SYSTEM.md — the root model.

## Provenance
Hebrew: liturgical text. Glosses and root analysis: original to this project.
No third-party published translation is redistributed.
Hebrew is authoritative; the English is a learning aid, not halacha.
